original_test_intent: Temporarily suspend approved BMC-generated ARP response and/or gratuitous ARP behavior on an isolated LAN channel, verify both reported state and bounded network effect, then restore normal behavior without losing access.

manual_activity: Network/FAE owner approves the watchdog baseline, channel, ARP bits, maximum duration, packet/reachability observation, recovery route and normal-state restore.

safety_requirements: Never use production/shared channel without recovery
Do not infer effect from packet absence alone

Verify both state bits and reachability
engineer_actions: Approve watchdog coupling and network impact

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run a recovery-backed baseline-suspend-observe-restore transaction with watchdog state pinned and both control/readback plus packet evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds standard operation, control-bit scope, behavioral oracle and recovery to an undefined source.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Reading ARP-control bits alone does not prove suspend behavior; packet absence alone is also insufficient without command state and negative-control context.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Suspending ARP responses can make management unreachable, while gratuitous-ARP suppression may affect convergence without immediate loss.

project_override_considerations: A vendor network-control API is equivalent only if it controls the same ARP-response/gratuitous behavior with watchdog-aware state, bounded observation and exact restore; raw 0x03 coverage remains unverified if skipped.
expected_evidence: Redacted 0x03 request/response and decoded present-state bits
Bounded packet/reachability observation with negative control

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master method and criteria are absent/TBD rather than contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The ARP-suspension purpose is identifiable. Watchdog state, bits, observation, recovery and approval are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Defines the missing watchdog-coupled ARP state machine and prevents read-only substitution, production reachability loss, packet-absence false positives and unbounded suspension.
independent_technical_reasoning: ARP behavior is externally observed and absence of frames is not proof unless traffic opportunity and capture placement are controlled. The command-reported bits, a bounded positive/negative network probe and an independent recovery path must agree; watchdog configuration changes may alter control validity, so cleanup must account for that coupling before declaring restoration.
